sets.relationshipLabel: a shinobi specialist and the signature tool of their craft
sets.explanation: Each specialist is defined by the tool that makes their craft possible: medical-nin cut with chakra scalpels, puppeteers command chakra strings.

sets.relationshipLabel: a class of being and one specific member named
sets.explanation: A tailed beast is a category and Kurama is one of its nine members, just as Jiraiya is one of the three legendary Sannin.

sets.relationshipLabel: the same kind of thing, early and small scale then later and greater scale
sets.explanation: Each pair tracks the same thing growing from its smallest form to its largest: a recruit becomes a veteran, a spark becomes an inferno.

sets.relationshipLabel: an earlier turning point and the later moment it leads to across one story
sets.explanation: Each first event sets up the later one as its narrative consequence: sealing the Kyuubi made its extraction possible, and the Uchiha Massacre set Itachi on the path to his own death.
